review_method: FFmpeg decoded selected frames directly from actual MP4 to unscaled 1080x1920 PNG; every selected PNG individually opened using view_image in chronological batches. No contact sheets or source edits. No real-time full movie playback available.

observations.road_motion: Visible sequential lane, wall, vegetation movement in road windows and changing wheel spokes. No freeze apparent in sampled sequences. Exact speed/rolling correspondence and all-frame behavior not certified.
observations.camera: Cuts occur at specified boundaries; no extra within-window camera pop or transient occluder observed. Whole car fits reveal, flight and rear ending windows. Wheel/interior/POV crops are purposeful.
observations.mechanical_story: Rotating turbo, reciprocating pistons/crank and moving colored flow markers read as an explanatory schematic. Driver hands remain near steering wheel; feet near pedals. Physical engineering correctness and exact connections are not certified.
observations.captions: Engine captions and two-line final caption remain readable inside lower safe margins, clear of subject. Proof title ends with isolated PROOF on second line.
observations.lighting: Teal paint catches broad highlights; dark lower grille/rear details and tires lose separation. Road scenes have flat, muted lighting and visibly repeated procedural vegetation/stonework.
observations.art_quality: Clearly stylized procedural vehicle, mannequin and environment. Adequate proof readability, but no premium automotive beauty certification.

findings.finding: Tire closeup reads weakly grounded: lower silhouette stays round with little contact-patch cue and soft shadow appears separated below. This is a visual concern, not proof of a geometric gap; reported geometry passes were not repeated.
findings.recommendation: Inspect moving closeup and improve contact shadow/contact-patch visual cue if realism is required.

findings.finding: POV has a very large plain straight diagonal background boundary behind road/trees, which reads as a procedural environment edge or slab rather than natural mountain silhouette. Dark dashboard occupies roughly lower third.
findings.recommendation: Art review background silhouette and tonal depth before beauty approval.

findings.finding: Transparent body shell produces broad layered ghost lines across driver/seat/dashboard. Cutaway purpose remains readable but visual layering is busy.
findings.recommendation: Review transparency ordering and simplify shell overlay if polish is required.

limitations: 88 inspected frames cover local 0.13–0.2 second windows only; cannot establish continuous 22 second motion quality or pacing.
Silent proof: audio, narration and synchronization unreviewed.
No beauty approval or full playback pass granted.
